original_benchmark.notes: Public evaluations of LatchBio's benchmarks.bio suite that ship both input data and a deterministic grader and whose data is still readable: scBench 6, SpatialBench 16, VariantBench 6, MetagenomicsBench 4, TxBench-Preclinical-Pharmacology 12. Agent versions are the ones pinned by latch-eval-tools 0.4.54 and its agent image.

Full benchmarks behind the five adapted repositories (scBench 195, SpatialBench 159, VariantBench 118, MetagenomicsBench 100, TxBench-PP 100). Upstream withholds everything outside the public subsets to prevent training contamination. The other eight benchmarks of the suite publish only prompts, or prompts without graders, and are not adaptable; see the README.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity ran on all 44 tasks (4 vCPU / 32 GB / 6 h), three runs per side: original 40.91 ± 2.27, Harbor 38.64 ± 1.31. parity_costs is what the 44-task experiment would cost at API list prices (as reported by Claude Code); the runs were billed to a Claude subscription. A reduced-resource replication on the 38 small-data tasks (6 GiB / 30 min) also matches and is described in the README (about $430 at list prices). Input data (37.8 GiB) is downloaded from a pinned Hugging Face mirror at image build time. The graders are the latch-eval-tools 0.4.54 release installed in each task image; no upstream grader code is copied into the adapter or the tasks.
